suits: batch cooks wanting pressure and slow cooking with a stainless-steel inner bowl

small kitchens without safe steam clearance or room to store the lid and accessories

products.name: Ninja Foodi SmartLid Multi Cooker OL650ANZ
products.summary: A 7.5 L, 14-function multi-cooker combining pressure cooking, slow cooking, steaming and air frying for larger households trying to consolidate several cooking jobs.
drawbacks: At about 11.4 kg and roughly 38 cm high and deep, it is difficult to move and store in a compact kitchen.
The cooking pot, basket, rack, lid components and sealing parts create a more involved cleaning routine.
Australian owner feedback is mixed on the non-stick pot and after-sales support, so the surface, replacement-part path and warranty terms should be checked.

suits: larger households wanting pressure, slow-cook, steam-and-crisp and air-fry functions in one machine
batch cooks with a permanent bench position who will use several of the 14 functions
mayNotSuit: compact kitchens, frequent cupboard storage or users who cannot comfortably move an 11.4 kg appliance
households wanting a simple pressure cooker with minimal parts and controls
